module: "Track Vehicle" node (category `repeat_instant`). Lets the flowgraph track a vehicle created outside of it (`mgr.modules.vehicle:addVehicle(veh, {dontDelete})`). Input pins: `flow`, `vehId` (default 0), `dontDelete` (hidden, default true: do not delete on stop).
notes: No fallback to the player vehicle despite the pin description; a nil `vehId` causes `findObjectById(nil)`.
Called every frame while the flow is active.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

work.desc: Adds the vehicle to the manager's vehicle module.
